name: Funäsdalen

seo.title: Funäsfjällen ski resort guide
seo.description: Six ski areas and more than 153 runs around Funäsdalen, linked by 300 kilometres of cross-country track in western Jämtland.
seo.twitterDescription: Six ski areas, 153 runs and 300 km of cross-country track.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts per area, where to stay and how to get to Funäsdalen and Funäsfjällen in Jämtland, Sweden.

h1: Funäsdalen ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Funäsdalen sits in the middle of Funäsfjällen, six separate ski areas holding more than 153 runs between them. Tänndalen has the most pistes at 57, Ramundberget the most descents at 50, and 300 kilometres of connecting cross-country track runs between the villages.
stayOverview: Funäsfjällen is six villages rather than one resort. Funäsdalen itself has the cable car up Funäsdalsberget and the most services; Ramundberget and Tänndalen have the most skiing; Tännäskröket and Tänndalsvallen are small and quiet.
hotelIntro: Pick the area before the bed: the six are a drive apart, and the one you book decides whether you have 57 pistes at the door or 2.
rentalCars: A car is close to necessary here. The six areas are separate villages linked by road, and the cross-country track is what connects them on skis.

travelTips.title: Which area
travelTips.text: Tänndalen has 57 pistes and 18 lifts; Tänndalsvallen has 2 pistes and 1 lift. They are not interchangeable.

travelTips.title: Cross-country first
travelTips.text: 300 kilometres of connecting track links five of the six areas, and Kappruet has 100 km of its own.

travelTips.title: Off-piste at Tännäskröket
travelTips.text: Tännäskröket marks 8 runs as off-piste alongside its 9 groomed descents.

travelTips.title: Pre-season
travelTips.text: Bruksvallarna opens for cross-country from 24 October.

highlights.title: Funäsdalsberget
highlights.text: The mountain above the village, with 5 lifts, 18 pistes and 330 metres of vertical.

highlights.title: Ramundberget
highlights.text: The largest of the six areas: 10 lifts and 50 descents.

highlights.title: Tänndalen
highlights.text: 57 pistes served by 18 lifts, 16 of them drag lifts.

highlights.title: Tännäskröket
highlights.text: Nine groomed descents and eight runs the resort marks as off-piste.

highlights.title: The cross-country network
highlights.text: 300 kilometres of connecting track between Funäsdalsberget, Ramundberget, Tänndalen, Tänndalsvallen and Tännäskröket.

highlights.title: Kappruet
highlights.text: Two lifts and nine descents, with 100 kilometres of its own cross-country track.

lifts.unannounced: Funäsfjällen publishes a lift count for each of its six areas but no total for the destination, and adding them would be our arithmetic rather than theirs.

verticalDrop.note: Stated for Funäsdalsberget only; no drop is published for the other five areas.

topElevation.unannounced: No summit elevation is published for any of the six areas.

season.unannounced: No overall season dates are published. The site gives a pre-season cross-country start at Bruksvallarna on 24 October 2026.

snowpark.note: The destination site says there are many parks without giving a count.

pistes.note: The operator's own total across its six areas: 57 pistes at Tänndalen, 50 at Ramundberget, 18 at Funäsdalsberget, 9 at Kappruet, 9 at Tännäskröket and 2 at Tänndalsvallen.

baseElevation.unannounced: The operator gives 330 m of vertical at Funäsdalsberget and counts the lifts and runs in each of its six areas, but states no altitude above sea level for any of them.

longestRun.note: The only one of the six areas for which the operator publishes a longest run.

dayPass.unannounced: Funäsfjällen had not published an adult day rate for the 2026/27 winter on its own site as of 24 October 2026.

facts.label: Ski areas
facts.value: 6: Funäsdalsberget, Kappruet, Ramundberget, Tänndalen, Tänndalsvallen, Tännäskröket

facts.text: 300 kilometres of connecting track links Funäsdalsberget, Ramundberget, Tänndalen, Tänndalsvallen and Tännäskröket.
Kappruet alone has 100 kilometres of its own track.
Tännäskröket marks 8 of its runs as off-piste rather than groomed descent.

unannounced.statement: Funäsfjällen had not published an adult day rate for the 2026/27 winter on its own site as of 24 October 2026.
Funäsfjällen publishes the number of lifts and pistes per area but no split by difficulty, so no distribution is shown.
No overall season dates are published. The site gives a pre-season start at Bruksvallarna on 24 October 2026 and a cross-country season pass valid from the autumn break to the end of April.

sectors.name: Tänndalen
sectors.text: The largest of the six areas, with wide views and terrain the operator points at beginners and experienced skiers alike.

rows.label: At the lifts
rows.value: 8 restaurants and two sports shops with rental

sectors.name: Ramundberget
sectors.summary: 50 runs over 30 km, served by 10 lifts
sectors.text: Where the road ends: the operator sells this area on natural snow and off-piste rather than on its piste count, and the Fjällgårdsbanan lift reaches the cross-country track on the open mountain.

rows.label: For children
rows.value: Lillramis with Mickelinas Värld, on slopes the operator calls gentle

rows.label: At the lifts
rows.value: 5 restaurants, and a pool, gym and spa

sectors.name: Funäsdalsberget
sectors.summary: 18 pistes and 330 m of vertical, served by a gondola and 5 lifts
sectors.text: The home mountain above Funäsdalen itself, and the one area you reach from the village without a car.

rows.label: The gondola
rows.value: Funäsgondolen, from the village at the foot of the mountain

sectors.name: Kappruet
sectors.text: A small area between Messlingen and Mittådalen where every run ends at the same place, which is why the operator points families here.

sectors.name: Tännäskröket
sectors.summary: 9 groomed runs and a 2,000 m longest descent, served by 4 lifts
sectors.text: South-facing slopes, with marked off-piste runs beside the pisted ones and no black graded piste.

rows.label: Pistes by grade
rows.value: 5 blue and 4 red, and no black

sectors.name: Tänndalsvallen
sectors.summary: 2 pistes, served by one drag lift
sectors.text: The smallest area in Funäsfjällen: one drag lift, ski-in access from the houses around it, and the cross-country track as the reason most people come.

ski.sectorsNote: Funäsfjällen is six separate areas on one pass, not one ski area, so each count below is that area's own.
